notes: Derived from a SINGLE observed VIN on the 2026-08-01 capture vehicle. One
VIN cannot tell us which characters are model-discriminating and which are
unit-specific, so this prefix may be either too narrow (missing other
Windsor Pro builds) or too wide (also matching the standard Windsor).
Collect VINs from several cars of each model to tighten it.
Only characters 1-9 are stored: manufacturer + model/body/powertrain. The
unit-identifying tail (plant, serial) is deliberately omitted, so this
identifies a MODEL, not a car.
Position 10 on this VIN is '8', which ISO 3779 reads as model year 2008 —
the vehicle is a confirmed 2026. JSW MG Motor India does not follow the ISO
year code, so year must never be inferred from the VIN for this marque.
